messages:
Maya (Marketing): Quick idea - run a "Micro-Lab: Real-time Inference" webinar, 40m total. Goal: show concrete knobs to cut cost without blowing latency. Need: short abstract, 3 micro-demos, and an attendee lab.
Evan (Product): Love it. I'll own the scenarios. Propose: 1) Chat support (low-cost batching), 2) Live notes (KV prefix caching), 3) Streaming agent with graceful fallback. Each demo 5-6m.
Riya (DevEx): I'll build a canonical prompt pack + a single input schema (JSON: {"text","metadata"}) so attendees can plug-and-play. Also will add one-click import for the lab.
Sam (Ops): Ops requirements: staging hook with replay tokens, canary route, pre-bound fallback variant, and a 10-min smoke test before go. I'll draft a one-page runbook.
Leo (Eng): I'll wire a tiny demo toggle endpoint to switch quantization/profile mid-stream. Example pseudo: 
```
POST /demo/switch {"profile":"cpu-saver"}
sleep 5
POST /demo/switch {"profile":"low-latency"}
```
Emma (Growth): I can moderate. Prefer script bullets and a handoff cue to engineers.
Maya (Marketing): Draft abstract for sign-up?
Evan (Product): "Micro-Lab: Serving interactive LLM features — pragmatic knobs for latency, cost, and reliability with replayable demos."
Maya (Marketing): Run-of-show draft: 
• 00:00-02:00 - Host welcome + goals
• 02:00-08:00 - Patterns & decision matrix (when to batch/cache/quantize)
• 08:00-24:00 - Three micro-demos (6 min each incl. debrief)
• 24:00-34:00 - Attendee lab (import prompts + run)
• 34:00-40:00 - Live Q&A + follow-ups
Riya (DevEx): Rehearsals: 
- Internal dry run: Tue 11:00 (full flow)
- Ops failover sim: Wed 15:00 (latency spike + fallback)
- Dress: Thu 09:00 (hosts + countdown)
Sam (Ops): Lead capture: tag intent fields on registration ("use_case","company_tier","trial_ready"). Webhook to /webhooks/marketing/leads. Prioritize enterprise-intent leads into SDR queue.
Leo (Eng): I'll add the webhook stub and map fields in staging. Deploying demo-harness v1.7 to staging now.
deploy-bot: Deployment started: staging/demo-harness v1.7 -> staging at 1742939060 by Leo
Maya (Marketing): Action items: Evan - finalize demo scripts + 1-line blurbs (EOD). Riya - prompt pack + import flow (tomorrow AM). Sam - runbook + smoke checklist (day before). Leo - demo toggle + webhook in staging (today). Emma - confirm moderation script (tomorrow).
Evan (Product): Acknowledged, I'll drop the scenarios in the doc by 5pm.
Riya (DevEx): Acknowledged. I'll add reproducibility checks.
Sam (Ops): I'll send the runbook draft by EOD and set the smoke-test calendar invite.
Maya (Marketing): Great — I'll draft registration copy and coordinate recording + follow-up assets. :rocket:
